mute_help: One click and the bot goes silent everywhere, right now. Your commands and settings are kept: you can switch it back on whenever you like.
mute_on: The bot is MUTED: it no longer answers anyone.{when}
muted_done: Done: the bot no longer answers anyone.
listen_title: Is the bot listening to your chat?
listen_yes: The bot is listening to your chat: yes.
listen_no: The bot is listening to your chat: no.
listen_nomsg: No message received yet: type a command in your chat to try it.
listen_live_only: It answers only while you are live.
listen_always: It answers even when you are not live.
listen_pending: Starting up: Twitch is checking that your site answers. Come back in a minute and click “Check now”.
listen_no_channel: No Twitch channel is set up on this site. Open “My Twitch channel” in your features and enter your channel.
listen_channel_unknown: The channel chosen for the bot is no longer one of your Twitch channels. Choose another one in the bot's settings.
listen_creds_missing: Your channel's Twitch application (its ID and secret) is missing.
listen_need_connect: Twitch has not yet given you the permission to read and write in your chat.
listen_need_reconnect: Twitch asks for your permission again (it was withdrawn or has expired).
listen_need_more: A chat permission is missing at Twitch: click the button below and leave all the boxes ticked.
listen_bot_need_connect: The bot account is not connected yet.
listen_bot_reconnect: Twitch asks for the bot account's permission again.
listen_bot_more: A permission is missing at Twitch for the bot account: connect it again.
listen_site_private: Twitch cannot reach your site: it needs a public https:// address (a site on your computer or a test site will not do).
listen_revoked: Twitch stopped sending the chat messages (the permission was withdrawn or the account changed). The bot tries to start listening again by itself; otherwise click “Repair listening”.
listen_twitch_busy: Twitch is limiting requests right now. Nothing to do: the bot tries again by itself.
listen_twitch_down: Twitch is not answering right now. Nothing to do: the bot tries again by itself every 10 minutes.
listen_refused: Twitch refused to start listening ({detail}). Check the Twitch application (ID and secret) then click “Repair listening”.
listen_failure_revoked: Twitch had stopped listening because the permission had been withdrawn.
listen_failure_unreachable: Twitch had stopped listening because your site was not answering it.
check_ok: Checked: the bot is listening to your chat.
check_done: Check done: read the message at the top of the page to know what to do.
relisten_ok: Listening was restarted. Come back in a minute and click “Check now”.
connect_steps:
**For the bot to read and write in your chat, Twitch must first ask for your consent. It is quick, and only once.**

**1.** Click the button below.

**2.** At Twitch, sign in with your channel's account then click “Authorize”. You come back here by yourself.
connect_bot_steps:
**Connect the account that will answer in your chat.**

**1.** Click the button below.

**2.** At Twitch, sign in with the bot's account (not yours) then click “Authorize”.
creds_steps: **Before going on:** open the [Twitch connector]({href}) and follow its guide to fill in your site's Twitch application. Then come back here: the permission button will appear.
no_channel_steps: **Before going on:** add your channel in the “My Twitch channel” feature.
res_denied: You refused the permission at Twitch. Click the button again then “Authorize”.
res_refused: Twitch refused the connection. Check the ID, the secret and the return address of your Twitch application (see “Twitch connector”), then try again.
res_network: Twitch is not answering right now. Try again in a few minutes.
res_rate: Twitch is limiting requests right now. Try again in a few minutes.
res_expired: The connection link had expired (10 minutes). Click the button again.
res_wrongAccount: You signed in at Twitch with the account “{login}”, which is not your channel's. Sign in again with the right account.
res_scope: A permission is missing at Twitch. Try again and leave all the boxes ticked.
bot_help: You chose to have another Twitch account answer in your chat. Create that account at Twitch, then connect it with the button that appears above once everything else is ready.
summary_help: This is everything the bot can do, with its state. Type for example {prefix}jeu in your chat to try. To change a command, click “Edit”.
why_planning_absent: Hidden: no streams calendar is installed. Add “Online calendar” or “Hand-written streams” for this command to answer.
why_followers_absent: Hidden: the follower count is not available. In “My Twitch channel”, tick “Follow my statistics” and connect your channel.
why_group_empty: Hidden: no network command is switched on.
why_partner_missing: Paused: this partner's page cannot be found or is not published.
why_network_missing: Paused: this network is no longer installed or has no address any more.
cmd_followers_text: {utilisateur}, the community has {followers} followers, thank you all!
fb_jeu: a game still to be announced
f_name_help: What people type after the {prefix}. Letters, digits, dashes; 25 characters at most.
f_aliases_help: Separated by commas. For example: insta, ig.
f_text_help: You can drop in pieces that fill themselves in: {vars}. The text cannot start with / or a dot.
f_enabled_chat: Switch the command on in the chat
f_cd_global: Wait between two answers, for everyone (seconds)
f_cd_help: Leave empty to use the default wait (set in advanced mode).
edit_unknown: This command does not exist (any more). Pick one from the list.
edit_preview: **Preview of the answer** (with the current information, nothing is sent): {text}
edit_network_info: Network: **{name}**, address: {address}. The command name is suggested from the network, then it is yours: it no longer changes afterwards.
edit_group_info: This command gives, in one go, the addresses of all the networks whose command is switched on. You can switch it off.
network_gone: This network is no longer installed or has no address any more: its command is paused. It will disappear if it does not come back within two weeks.
partners_absent: This feature appears when you install the **Sponsors** module: each partner can then have its own chat command (for example !tesla, which gives the address of its page).
partners_none: The Sponsors module is installed, but no page is published yet. Publish one to give it its command.
partners_help: A partner's command is set up in its page, in the “Chat command for this partner” section: “Edit” takes you there, with the command's name and text already filled in for you. The title and address come from the page, so they are always up to date.
networks_none: No network is connected yet. Install a network module (YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, Discord…) and enter your address in it: it will appear here with its command.
networks_help: For each network whose address is set, switch its chat command on: “Set up” opens the command name, its other names and its text, already filled in for you.
log_help: The last 30 recognized commands. If the bot did not answer, the reason is written here.
log_empty: Nothing yet: the log fills in as soon as a command is typed in your chat.
reason_hidden: Something is missing for this command (see its line above).
reason_missing: The command is paused (page or network not found).
reason_live_unknown: Could not tell whether you are live. The bot does not answer when in doubt.
reason_offline: You were not live (can be changed in the settings).
reason_role: This person is not allowed to use this command.
reason_cooldown: Too soon: {seconds} s still to wait.
reason_rate: Too many answers at once: the bot holds back so Twitch does not block it.
reason_not_ready: The bot is not ready (see “Is the bot listening” at the top of the page).
reason_send_denied: Twitch refused to send: permission to renew (see the top of the page).
reason_send_dropped: Twitch did not publish the message.
reason_send_rate: Twitch is limiting sending right now.
reason_send_twitch: Twitch is not answering right now.
err_name: The command name “{value}” is not valid. Use letters, digits, dashes or underscores (25 characters at most), no space.
err_alias: The other name “{value}” is not valid. Use letters, digits, dashes or underscores, no space, separated by commas.
err_aliases_many: There are too many other names: 5 at most. Remove some.
err_collision: The name “{word}” is already taken by the “{with}” command. Pick another name.
err_text_unknown: This text contains pieces the bot does not know: {vars}. Remove them or replace them with one of these: {allowed}.
err_text_empty: The answer text is empty. Write what the bot should answer.
err_text_long: The text is too long (450 characters at most). Shorten it.
err_text_start: The text cannot start with / or a dot, nor with the command sign. Start with a word.
err_delay: A wait must be a number of seconds between 0 and 3600, or stay empty.
err_role: Pick who can use the command from the list.
err_too_many: You reached the maximum number of commands of your own (100). Delete some before adding more.
err_source_missing: The partner or the network no longer exists (or is no longer published). Nothing was saved.
err_unknown: This command does not exist (any more).
entry_unpublished: This page is not published yet. You can set up the command now: it stays paused until the page is visible on the site.
entry_bot_not_ready: The bot is not listening to your chat yet: this command will not answer until that is fixed. Click here to see what to do.
entry_saved_unpublished: Saved. The command will wait until the page is published.
partners_paused: Paused (the page is no longer published or is gone): {list}. These commands are removed automatically after two weeks.
edit_partner_moved: A partner's command is now set up in the partner's own page. [Open the page]({href})
edit_network_module: [Change the address in this network's module]({href})
entry_bot_not_ready_editor: The bot is not listening to your chat yet: this command will not answer until that is fixed. Ask whoever administers the site to open the bot's page.
rw_intro:
Your viewers spend their channel points to trigger something: an answer from the bot in the chat or, with the Home Assistant connector, the colour of your lights or a message read aloud at your place.

**In 3 steps:** 1. Turn rewards on here and allow Twitch (once). 2. Create a first reward, for example “Red”. 3. For lights and voice, install the Home Assistant connector (offered below) and pair it.

Twitch only offers channel points to Affiliate or Partner accounts.
rw_enabled: Done. If Twitch needs a permission, an “Allow” button appears just below.
rw_connect_steps: Twitch has to ask your permission again, once, so the site can create your rewards. Click the button, accept at Twitch, then come back here. The chat keeps working meanwhile.
rw_access_no_channel: No Twitch channel is chosen for this bot.
rw_access_creds_missing: Your site's Twitch application is not set up yet.
rw_access_need_connect: Your channel is not connected to Twitch yet.
rw_access_need_reconnect: Twitch no longer recognises your connection: it has to be allowed again.
rw_access_need_scope: The permission to manage rewards is missing.
rw_access_twitch_down: Twitch is not answering right now. Try again in a moment.
rw_na: Twitch does not offer channel points to this account: you need to be an Affiliate or Partner. Nothing is broken: as soon as Twitch grants it, everything works here without redoing anything.
rw_listen_need_scope: The site is not receiving point exchanges yet: the permission to manage rewards is missing.
rw_listen_site_private: The site is not receiving point exchanges: its address cannot be reached by Twitch (a public https address is needed).
rw_listen_twitch_down: The site could not check that it receives exchanges: Twitch is not answering. Try again in a moment.
rw_listen_twitch_busy: Twitch asks to wait a little. Try again in a minute.
rw_listen_refused: Twitch refused to send us the point exchanges. Use “Check now” in the Commands tab.
rw_listen_pending: Twitch is checking your site's address to send point exchanges. It takes a few moments.
rw_extra_bad: These actions added by hand are ignored, they are not written correctly: {list}. Example: lumieres:orange.
rw_house_absent: To change the colour of your lights or read messages aloud at your place, you need the Home Assistant connector. Without it you can still create rewards that answer in the chat.
rw_suggest_reason: runs actions at your place (lights, voice) when viewers spend their points
rw_house_unpaired: The home is not paired yet. Open the Home Assistant connector to pair it.
rw_house_off: The home is switched off (“Cut everything” button or !stop). Home rewards are paused on Twitch.
rw_house_notlive: You are not live: home rewards are paused on Twitch and will come back by themselves.
rw_house_ok: The home is ready: home rewards are on sale.
rw_house_link_help: Pair Home Assistant, see whether the home is ready and find the “Cut everything” button: it is all set up in the Home Assistant connector.
rw_unmapped_banner: Home Assistant does not have a script for these yet: {list}. Open Home Assistant > Curiosa > Configure to link them.
rw_list_empty: No reward yet. Create the first one with the form below.
rw_delete_confirm: Delete this reward at Twitch? Viewers will no longer be able to take it.
rw_new_help: It is created at Twitch right away and visible to your viewers (unless the home is switched off).
rw_f_title_help: What your viewers see, {max} characters at most. Example: Red lights.
rw_f_cooldown_help: Wait between two uses, for everyone. 0 or empty: none. Example: 2.
rw_f_prompt_help: One sentence shown under the title. Optional, {max} characters at most.
rw_f_input_help: Needed to read a message aloud (ticked automatically for that action).
rw_w_lights: Change the colour of the lights
rw_f_what: What happens when someone takes this reward?
rw_f_what_help: For anything else (start the vacuum, open the shutters…), pick “Something else at my place” and give it a name.
rw_f_color_help: Only for “Change the colour of the lights”.
rw_f_an_help: Only for “Something else at my place”. Example: Start the vacuum. {max} characters at most. If this name is already in “Your actions”, the same action is used again.
rw_f_key_help: Optional, to link your home by hand. Left empty, it is made from the name. Lowercase letters, digits, “:” “_” “-”, 40 characters at most. Example: vacuum:start. Only used for a new action.
rw_f_reply_help: Only for “Answer in the chat”. You can write {utilisateur} (the viewer's name) and {recompense}. Example: Thanks {utilisateur}!
rw_e_title: Give the reward a title. Example: Red lights.
rw_e_title_long: This title is too long: {max} characters at most. Example: Red lights.
rw_e_dup: One of your rewards already has this title. Pick another one, for example Red lights 2.
rw_e_what: Pick what happens from the list. Example: Change the colour of the lights.
rw_e_color: Pick a colour from the list. Example: Red.
rw_e_an_empty: Give this action a name. Example: Start the vacuum.
rw_e_an_long: This name is too long: {max} characters at most. Example: Start the vacuum.
rw_e_an_too_many: You already have {limit} actions. Remove one in “Your actions” before creating another.
rw_e_an_dup: Another of your actions already has this name. Pick another one, for example Start the living room vacuum.
rw_e_key: Write an identifier with lowercase letters, digits, “:” “_” “-”, 40 characters at most. Example: vacuum:start.
rw_e_key_taken: This identifier is already used by another action. For example, try vacuum:start-2.
rw_e_cost: Write a whole number of points, from 1. Example: 500.
rw_e_cooldown: Write a number of minutes between 0 and 1440. Example: 2.
rw_e_prompt: This text is too long: {prompt} characters at most.
rw_e_action: Pick what happens from the list. Example: Change the colour of the lights.
rw_e_reply_empty: Write the bot's answer. Example: Thanks {utilisateur}!
rw_e_reply_long: This answer is too long: 450 characters at most.
rw_e_reply_start: The answer cannot start with / or . or with the start of a command. Example: Thanks {utilisateur}!
rw_e_reply_vars: These words in braces are not allowed: {vars}. Allowed: {utilisateur} {recompense} {jeu} {titre} {uptime} {followers} {prochain_stream}.
rw_err_na: Twitch does not offer channel points to this account: you need to be an Affiliate or Partner.
rw_err_dup: Twitch already has a reward with this title. Pick another one, for example Red lights 2.
rw_err_too_many: You reached the maximum of {max} rewards. Delete one before creating another.
rw_err_rate: Twitch asks to wait a little. Try again in a minute.
rw_err_gone: This reward no longer exists at Twitch (or was not created by this site).
rw_err_denied: Twitch's permission to manage rewards is missing. Use the “Allow” button above.
rw_err_setup: The bot is not ready: see “Is the bot listening” in the Commands tab.
rw_err_twitch: Twitch is not answering right now. Nothing was changed: try again in a moment.
rw_err_action_home: This action needs the Home Assistant connector. Install it from the “The home” section of this tab, then try again.
rw_created: The reward “{title}” is created at Twitch.
rw_created_link: The reward “{title}” is created on Twitch. Last step: in Home Assistant, open Curiosa > Configure and pick a script for “{action}”.
rw_log_help: The last {n} point exchanges. The message a viewer writes is never kept.
rw_log_settle: Answer to Twitch on its way
rw_reason_not_installed: the Home Assistant connector is not installed
rw_reason_failed: the home could not do it
rw_reason_ignored: the home does not know this action
rw_reason_unmapped: Home Assistant does not have a script for this action yet. Open Home Assistant > Curiosa > Configure to link it.
rw_reason_disabled: the switch is off in Home Assistant
redeem_notice: {user}, your reward “{reward}” could not be played: your points are given back.
kill_stopped: The home was switched off by {user}.
kill_started: The home is switched back on.
kill_absent: The Home Assistant connector is not installed: nothing to switch off.
kill_failed: I could not do it right now.
reason_not_installed: The Home Assistant connector is not installed.
rw_sim_help: To check that everything works without spending points: the simulation behaves like a real exchange, with a fake viewer called “Test”, but never contacts Twitch. A home action is really sent to your place; a chat answer is only shown, never sent.
rw_sim_f_text_help: Only for the reward that reads a message aloud. Example: Hello everyone!
rw_sim_no_text: This reward reads a message: write it here. Example: Hello everyone!
rw_sim_off: The home is switched off (“Cut everything” button or !stop): the simulation is refused for safety. Switch the home back on, then try again.
rw_sim_too_fast: A little patience: one simulation every 3 seconds at most.
rw_sim_too_many: You ran 30 simulations this hour. Try again later.
rw_sim_preview: This is what the bot would write in the chat (nothing is sent): {text}
rw_sim_pending: Sent to the home. No answer yet: the result will show in “Latest exchanges” (open this tab again).
rw_sim_done: Test passed: sent, picked up by Home Assistant and carried out.
rw_sim_failed: The home answered, but the action was not done: {why}
rw_pause_help: A paused reward stays visible at Twitch but nobody can take it.
rw_acts_help: What your rewards can start at your place. The name chosen here is the one you find in Home Assistant (Curiosa > Configure) to pick a script. Renaming it breaks nothing.
rw_acts_name_help: The name changes everywhere. What is linked in Home Assistant stays linked.
rw_acts_key_help: Advanced. Changing the identifier breaks the link in Home Assistant, to redo over there. When in doubt, leave it as it is.
rw_acts_remove_confirm: Remove this action from the list? No reward uses it.
rw_action_used: A reward still uses this action: change the reward first.
rw_action_legacy: This action comes from the “Other actions you can pick” setting (advanced mode): remove it from there.
err_arg_heure: This time zone does not exist. Write for example {heure Europe/Paris}, or just {heure} to use yours.
err_arg_date: This time zone does not exist. Write for example {date Europe/Paris}, or just {date} to use yours.
err_arg_aleatoire: {aleatoire} needs a list of at least two choices separated by | or a range of numbers. For example {aleatoire yes | no | maybe} or {aleatoire 1-100}.
err_arg_calcul: The calculation is not understood. It accepts numbers, + - * / % ^, parentheses and abs, round, floor, ceil, min, max, sqrt. For example {calcul 2+3*4}.
err_arg_urlfetch: {urlfetch} needs an https:// address of a real website. For example {urlfetch https://api.example.org/phrase}. The website must also be allowed in the advanced settings.
err_text_deep: The pieces are nested too deeply (3 levels at most). Simplify the text.
err_timer_name: Give the timer a name (40 characters at most). For example: Discord reminder.
err_timer_dup: A timer already has this name. Pick another one, for example: Discord reminder 2.
err_timer_minutes: The interval must be a whole number of minutes, from 1 to 1440. For example: 15.
err_timer_lines: The number of lines must be a whole number, from 0 to 200. For example: 5.
err_timer_many: You already have {max} timers, which is the maximum. Delete one to add another.
edit_counter: This command has been used {n} times. The {compteur} piece shows this number.
counter_reset_done: The counter is back to zero.
reason_invalid: Request refused: the bot explained why in the chat.
mg_list_none: {user}, there is no custom command yet.
mg_usage_addcom: {user}, to add one: {prefix}addcom name text of the reply. For example: {prefix}addcom discord Come and join us on Discord.
mg_usage_editcom: {user}, to change one: {prefix}editcom name new text. For example: {prefix}editcom discord The new link is in the description.
mg_usage_delcom: {user}, to delete one: {prefix}delcom name. For example: {prefix}delcom discord.
mg_e_delay: {user}, the delay must be a number of seconds from 0 to 3600. For example: -cd=30.
mg_e_level: {user}, the level must be everyone, subs, mods or owner. For example: -ul=mods.
mg_e_option: {user}, the option “{value}” does not exist. The options are -cd=seconds and -ul=level.
mg_e_name: {user}, the name “{value}” does not work: letters, digits, - and _ only, 25 characters at most.
mg_e_exists: {user}, the command {prefix}{name} already exists. To change it, type {prefix}editcom {name} new text.
mg_e_taken: {user}, the name {prefix}{name} is already taken by a ready-made command. Pick another name.
mg_e_many: {user}, there are already {max} custom commands, which is the maximum.
mg_e_notmine: {user}, {prefix}{name} is a ready-made command: change it in the site's administration.
nb_link: Import my commands and timers from Nightbot
nb_no_right: Your role does not allow importing. Ask the person who administers the site.
nb_help: In Nightbot, open the commands page, select the list and copy it (Ctrl+C), then paste it below. You can do the same with the timers page. The site reads the list, shows what can be taken over, and **saves nothing before you confirm**. {max} lines at most. If copy and paste does not work, write one command per line (`!name message`) and one timer per line (`timer name | minutes | lines | message`).
nb_f_paste_help: Paste here. For example: !discord Join us on Discord!
nb_e_empty: Paste the list copied from Nightbot first.
nb_e_nothing: No command or timer was recognised. Try one command per line, for example: !discord Join us on Discord!
nb_analysed: {n} lines read. Check, then confirm below.
nb_summary: {total} lines read: {same} taken as they are, {adapted} adapted, {impossible} impossible.
nb_truncated: The list was longer: only the first {max} lines are read.
nb_pick_help: Tick what you want to import. When a name already exists, nothing is overwritten without your say: choose what to do.
nb_conflict_help: Skip keeps what exists; Replace changes it (custom commands and timers only); Rename adds the new one under another name.
nb_e_expired: The list you pasted has expired. Paste it again.
nb_e_none: Tick at least one line to import.
nb_cancelled: The list is dropped. Nothing was saved.
nb_n_level_regular: The “regular” level does not exist here: the command is limited to subscribers. Change it if you wish.
nb_n_level_unknown: Unknown level “{d}”: the command is limited to the moderation team, to be safe.
nb_n_cd_clamped: The delay is brought down to one hour.
nb_n_me_removed: The leading “/me” is removed (the bot cannot write in italics).
nb_n_braces: Curly brackets in the text are replaced with parentheses.
nb_n_urlfetch: {urlfetch} only works once you have allowed the website in the advanced settings.
nb_n_interval_default: Interval not found: 5 minutes. Check it.
nb_n_timer_lines: Chat lines are counted since the timer's last message, and the timer only writes when the chat is active.
nb_r_name_start: The name “{d}” starts with / or a dot, which is not allowed.
nb_r_name_bad: The name “{d}” does not work: letters, digits, - and _ only, 25 characters at most.
nb_r_timer_name_long: The timer name is longer than 40 characters.
nb_r_var_bad: The piece {d} has no equivalent (for safety, the bot runs no program and does not use what people type to build an address).
nb_r_text_long: The message is longer than 450 characters.
nb_r_text_start: The message starts with /, a dot or the command prefix.
nb_r_dup: This name already appears higher up in the list.
tm_intro: A timer writes a message in your chat at regular intervals: a Discord reminder, a tip… **A timer needs the chat to be active, as with Nightbot**: the bot only looks at its timers when a message arrives in the chat. A silent chat triggers none. At each message, at most one timer writes; the others wait for the next message.
tm_not_ready: The bot is not listening to your chat yet: timers will write nothing until that is set up (see the Commands tab).
tm_urlfetch_off: One of your timers uses {urlfetch}, which is switched off: allow the website in the advanced settings first.
tm_state_new: Ready: it starts counting from the next chat message
tm_state_wait: Waiting: {min} more min and {lines} more chat lines
tm_state_due: Due: writes at the next chat message
tm_send_confirm: Send this message in the chat right now?
tm_new_help: You can have {max} timers at most.
tm_f_name_help: To find it again, {max} characters at most. For example: Discord reminder.
tm_f_text_help: What the bot writes. You can drop in pieces that fill themselves in: {vars}. It cannot start with / or a dot.
tm_f_minutes_help: A whole number from 1 to {max}. For example: 15.
tm_f_lines: At least this many chat lines since its last message
tm_f_lines_help: Avoids writing in an empty chat. From 0 to {max}. For example: 5.
tm_sent: The message is sent in the chat.
tm_send_not_ready: The bot is not listening to your chat yet: nothing was sent.
tm_send_muted: The bot is switched off (emergency stop): nothing was sent.
tm_send_rate: The bot has already written a lot in the last few seconds: try again in a moment.
tm_send_send: Twitch did not accept the message. Try again in a moment.
per_phrase_once: Active from {from} to {to}, one time only.
per_utc: (UTC time: set your time zone to change this)
per_ended: Outside its period: the period is over.
per_e_nodate: {month} {day} does not exist. Pick another day, for example {month} 1.
per_e_year: Give the year, for example 2026, for a period that does not come back every year. Otherwise tick “Every year”.
per_e_order: The end must come after the start. For example: from 1 November 2026 to 30 November 2026.
per_e_text: Write the period like this: 01/11 - 30/11 (every year) or 01/11/2026 - 30/11/2026 (one time only).
per_e_iso: Write the dates like this: 11-01 and 11-30 (every year) or 2026-11-01 and 2026-11-30 (one time only).
per_e_incomplete: Choose the day AND the month, for the start as well as the end. For example: from 1 November to 30 November.
per_f_help: Optional. Leave empty to be always active. Outside the period nothing is deleted: it switches back on by itself.
per_f_yearly_help: Ticked, the period comes back every year (for example 1 November to 30 November). It can cross new year (15 December to 15 January).
per_f_from_year: Year of the start (only if the period does not come back)
per_f_to_year: Year of the end (only if the period does not come back)
per_f_year_help: Untick “Every year” and give the years, for example 2026.
nb_f_period_help: Nightbot has no dates: write them if you wish. For example 01/11 - 30/11 (every year) or 01/11/2026 - 30/11/2026 (one time).
